_readme: Hand-reviewed links from a hearing statement's author, exactly as bundestag.de prints it, to a Lobbyregister id.

build-hearings.mjs links only on an exact normalised name (plus a trailing acronym or a city that matches the register's own city). Everything else stays unlinked and is shown in the Bundestag's own wording.
Add an entry only after opening both the statement PDF and the register entry and confirming they are the same body - not a member, branch, or sister organisation.
A value of null records a reviewed 'do not link': use it when the automatic rule would link a name that is in fact a different body.
Every id is checked against the register on each build; an unknown id fails the build.
